LOGAN FINNEY PRODUCER/WRITER IDAHO PUBLIC TELEVISION 1455 N ORCHARD STREET BOISE, ID 83706 DESK: (208) 373-7367 CELL: (208) 627-9028 LOGAN.FINNEY@IDAHOPTV.ORG From: Mary McMahon <Mary.McMahon@idahoptv.org> Sent: Monday, March 23, 2026 10:07:11 AM To: Logan Finney <Logan.Finney@idahoptv.org>; Krystal Goodman <Krystal.Goodman@idahoptv.org> Cc: Michelle Curry <Michelle.Curry@idahoptv.org>; Scott Graf <Scott.Graf@idahoptv.org> Subject: RE: Copilot (and AI) guidelines Hi Logan, nice that you started with the guidelines. I don’t currently have a use case for Copilot but Krystal has used it in Office apps like Excel. If you’ve read the ITS AI policy I’m sure you know they prefer we use Microsoft Copilot. Copilot Chat is included in at no additional cost with our Microsoft 365 subscription. If you are experimenting with any other tools please read the use agreements carefully and fully consider what you’re feeding it. It’s pretty standard for AI tools to use your prompts and data to train their models.
